title: Multi-LLM and Multi-Prompt Strategies for COVID-19 Infodemic Detection in Chinese Social Media: An Empirical Evaluation

contributions.purpose: 在中文 COVID-19 谣言语料上做多 LLM 多 prompt 实证评测
contributions.mechanism: 10 个 LLM × 5 prompt 策略 × 640 医生核实谣言帖 = 32000 响应,单 Qwen judge 映射五级判定,temp=0.5
contributions.evaluation: 平均 strict 48.0%、lenient 61.2%,ambiguity<2%,均显著高于均猜基线(20%/40%);最优 Qwen3-235B-thinking no-role ≈84% strict/≈90% lenient
contributions.domain: LLM 谣言检测 / 中文社媒 infodemic
contributions.source_quote: An empirical, multi-LLM, multi-prompt evaluation on a previously established Chinese COVID-19 misinformation corpus

contributions.purpose: 揭示 source/date 上下文反而降低 flagging(H1 被驳)
contributions.mechanism: 对比 S1(no-role)与 S5(呼吸专家+来源日期)组内 composite score/ambiguity 变化
contributions.evaluation: 多数模型加上下文降 flagging(GLM-4 AirX composite 1.283→0.188,GPT-4o 0.133→-0.244),error rate 升 5-10pp;ambiguity 小降(GPT-4o 4.1→2.0%)
contributions.source_quote: adding source/date context tends to reduce flagging on this all-misinformation benchmark while modestly lowering ambiguity

contributions.purpose: 证明 persona 选择非普遍有益(H2 被驳)
contributions.mechanism: 对比呼吸专家(S3)vs 公共卫生专家(S2)persona 在呼吸主题内容上的表现
contributions.evaluation: lenient 多为负(GPT-4o -10.0pp,Gemini -8.1pp),仅 Llama-4 +1.1pp、Mistral +0.9pp;保守模型误接受 >50% 假帖
contributions.source_quote: persona choice (public-health vs respiratory specialist) is not uniformly beneficial across posts and prompts

contributions.purpose: 发布可复现资产支持中文 infodemic 监测
contributions.mechanism: 释放 prompts、code、judging templates、redacted logs;原始 Weibo 帖遵循前作协议不重发
contributions.evaluation: 定性(复现资产释放);IRB 批号 EC-2024-KS-211
contributions.source_quote: A reproducible release (prompts, code, judging templates, redacted logs) to support Chinese-language infodemic monitoring and future replication

self_declared_provenance.quote: We use the Chinese Social Media Misinformation Dataset (CSMID), established in the prior work [6]... we extracted all physician-verified misinformation posts... We do not add new data, relabel, or reproduce raw posts

notes: abstract 自声明 4 条贡献。核心含双假设被驳的负结果:H1(专家persona+上下文提升 strict 准确)被驳——上下文反降 flagging;H2(呼吸persona利呼吸内容)被驳。数据红旗:(1)破坏双盲——PDF 列全部 7 名真实作者姓名/单位/邮箱(PUMC、厦门理工、西安交大等)+挂'AI scientists/AI Research Agent'为作者,匿名会议未匿名。(2)全阳性 ground truth——640 帖全为谣言,'accuracy'仅测 flagging 倾向而非真实判别力(作者已自认为局限)。(3)潜在循环自证——用单个 Qwen judge 评分,而结论恰是 Qwen/中文模型(Qwen-thinking、Doubao)表现最好,judge 与最优候选同族;作者称已 mask 身份缓解但存偏风险。(4)Grok 用于核对文献引用。checklist AI 披露:hypothesis/experiments[B]、analysis/writing[C];代码 Claude 4 Sonnet 写,初稿 ChatGPT deep research,Gemini 润色。Q7 统计显著性[No](仅描述性,无 CI/检验)。方法学扎实、局限披露充分,主要问题为未匿名与全阳性基准设计。
